model_family: AHP-weighted decision support system with multinomial logit calibration
score_formula: AHP-weighted territorial attractiveness score over normalized accessibility/connectivity, environmental/infrastructure quality, socioeconomic/execution context, supply pressure, and demand heat.
risk_formula: logistic scaled from paper multinomial-logit beta signs plus project supply-risk extension
normalization: Project inputs normalized to 0-100; paper qualitative high/medium/low levels mapped to ordinal score bands; supply pressure is inverse-scored for opportunity
recommended_ml_upgrade: Extend the paper-backed AHP plus multinomial-logit model with labelled Indian micro-market observations, then compare Logistic Regression, Random Forest, Gradient Boosting, and XGBoost for investment-choice and risk prediction.
paper_alignment_note: Aligned to the base paper Real Estate Investment Choices and Decision Support Systems, Sustainability 2019, 11, 3110. AHP aggregate weights from Table 4 and multinomial-logit coefficient signs from Table 6 are mapped to the project's operational dashboard variables.
